acceptance_criteria.given: a user is on any page of the sandbox site
acceptance_criteria.then: they see a centered footer containing the current year and a GitHub icon/link
acceptance_criteria.when: they scroll to the bottom of the page

acceptance_criteria.given: the site is in light mode
acceptance_criteria.then: the year and GitHub link are clearly readable

acceptance_criteria.given: the site is in dark mode
acceptance_criteria.then: the year and GitHub link are clearly readable

acceptance_criteria.given: the user clicks the GitHub link in the footer

assumptions.assumption: The GitHub icon will be implemented as an inline SVG to maintain consistency with existing component patterns.
The existing Footer component in components/Footer.tsx is the correct location for these changes.

clarified_description: Update the existing site footer to include a link to the GitHub repository. The footer will display the current year and a GitHub icon accompanied by a link, all centered on the page. The styling will follow the existing Tailwind CSS patterns and ensure readability in both light and dark themes.

constraints.detail: Must use existing Tailwind CSS configuration and avoid introducing new npm packages for icons.
Theme handling must not cause a flash of unstyled or wrongly-themed content (per ANZ Frontend Coding Standards).

must: The system shall display the current year dynamically in the footer.
The system shall display a link to https://github.com/pixie-sandbox/pixie-sandbox-site in the footer.
The system shall include a GitHub icon alongside the repository link.
The system shall render the footer content centered on the page.
The system shall render the footer on every page of the site.
The system shall use an inline SVG for the GitHub icon to avoid new dependencies.
outcome: Users can see the current year and easily access the project's GitHub repository from a centered footer on every page.
rationale: The feature is an enhancement of an existing component. Centering the content provides a clean, modern look suitable for a sandbox site. Using inline SVGs and default Tailwind classes minimizes technical debt and maintains the existing design system without adding bloat.
should: The system shall use default Tailwind CSS link styling for the GitHub link.

criteria: Link is present on all pages
Link is clearly identifiable by an icon
user_stories.so_that: I can quickly visit the repository to view the code.
user_stories.want: a visible GitHub link in the footer

jobs_to_be_done: Find the source code for the sandbox site
users.name: Site Visitor
pain_points: Difficulty locating repository links in a minimal UI

wont: The system won't add any new external icon libraries.
The system won't implement a split layout (e.g., year on left, link on right).
